metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: This iconic teen comedy shares the witty social satire, high school hierarchy themes, and colorful aesthetic found in 'Clueless' and '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Like 'Clueless', this is a highly comforting and funny story about a deceptively smart blonde heroine who takes on a challenging environment with upbeat style.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A smart, fast-talking teen comedy that, like '10 Things I Hate About You', is inspired by a classic literary work (The Scarlet Letter) and features a sharp, sarcastic lead.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: An incredibly fun, lighthearted fantasy adventure with romantic elements that matches the whimsical, magical vibe of 'Fantastic Beasts' and 'Dungeons & Dragons'.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: If you loved the hilarious dynamics, mystery, and chaos of 'The Nice Guys' and 'Wake Up Dead Man', this fast-paced action-comedy is a perfect match.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A legendary comfort movie combining fantasy, swordplay, comedy, and romance. It matches the lighthearted genre-blending style of 'Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves'.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you enjoy 'Wake Up Dead Man', this first entry in the Benoit Blanc series delivers the same breezy, clever, and star-studded mystery-comedy vibe.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The direct sequel to 'Knives Out' offers another sunny, high-fashion comedic mystery that perfectly aligns with your love for ensemble comedies.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The ultimate comfort action-adventure movie. It blends historical fantasy, romance, and laugh-out-loud comedy in the same vein as 'Jumanji' and 'Dungeons & Dragons'.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Matches the colorful cosmic scale, witty banter, and energetic sci-fi action of 'Thor: Ragnarok' and 'Pacific Rim: Uprising'.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black (who also did 'The Nice Guys'), this hilarious, fast-talking neo-noir buddy comedy shares the exact same DNA of witty crime mischief.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: An uplifting, high-concept comedy about a video game NPC. It captures the modern, digital-adventure fun of the new 'Jumanji' films.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A stylized, high-octane action comedy with an eccentric ensemble cast and sharp-tongued humor that will appeal to fans of 'Thor: Ragnarok' and 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A hilarious, comforting 2000s teen comedy based on Shakespeare's 'Twelfth Night', making it a natural companion piece to '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A breezy, star-studded jungle adventure that shares the lighthearted romance and comedic action of the 'Jumanji' series.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A fun, energetic take on the horror genre. If you enjoyed the lighthearted campiness of 'Anaconda', you will love this comedy-focused survival adventure.

metas.name: Tremors
metas.description: A classic, beloved creature feature that relies heavily on comedy, charming characters, and campy thrills, matching the fun energy of 'Anaconda'.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: An underrated, charming post-apocalyptic adventure filled with giant creatures, heart, and humor. Perfect for fans of 'Jumanji' and 'Fantastic Beasts'.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: With its fast-paced visual comedy and video game aesthetics, this cult favorite appeals to fans of 'Thor: Ragnarok' and 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A gorgeous, highly comedic sci-fi animation that captures the quirky, chaotic energy and visual creativity of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: This whimsical French romantic comedy is legendary for its vibrant color palette, quirky characters, and magical realism, appealing to fans of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a fantasy twist (time travel) that captures the sweet, emotional, and comforting magic found in 'Practical Magic'.

metas.name: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
metas.description: A delightfully colorful, fashion-forward 90s comedy about female friendship that fans of 'Clueless' are guaranteed to love.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A high-energy, endlessly quotable teen sports comedy that carries the vibrant 90s/00s nostalgic comfort of 'Clueless' and '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: This lighthearted Disney film gently pokes fun at fairy tale tropes while delivering a highly comforting, magical rom-com experience perfect for fans of 'Practical Magic'.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A breezy, star-studded 'redneck heist' comedy with a highly clever script and laid-back vibe, matching the tone of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Starring Heath Ledger, this rock-and-roll medieval adventure is pure fun, featuring the same charm, modern humor, and romance of '10 Things I Hate About You' and 'D&D'.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A brilliantly written horror-comedy that perfectly balances genuine stakes with hilarious, comforting British humor. Great for fans of 'The Nice Guys' and 'Anaconda'.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A highly lighthearted superhero fantasy about a kid who gains powers, playing out like a magical action-comedy in the style of 'Jumanji' and 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Featuring Jim Carrey at his physical comedy peak, this cartoonish, supernatural comedy will delight fans of 'Ace Ventura: Pet Detective'.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Another classic Jim Carrey comedy that balances hilarious slapstick desperation with a sweet, comforting family story.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A sleek, hilarious modern romantic comedy with a stellar ensemble cast (including Ryan Gosling) that balances humor and romance beautifully.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud action-comedy featuring Melissa McCarthy and Jason Statham that delivers great physical humor and fun espionage action.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: Pure comfort cinema. This fast-paced, PG-rated adventure-mystery is incredibly fun, easy to watch, and matches the puzzle-solving vibes of 'Jumanji' and 'D&D'.

metas.name: Emma.
metas.description: This visually stunning, highly comedic adaptation of Jane Austen's novel shares the exact same source material roots as 'Clueless' but with a gorgeous period-piece aesthetic.

metas.name: Never Been Kissed
metas.description: A heartwarming, cozy 90s romantic comedy starring Drew Barrymore that perfectly matches the high school nostalgia of '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: Enola Holmes
metas.description: A bright, energetic Victorian mystery adventure featuring a witty, fourth-wall-breaking heroine. Perfect for fans of 'Fantastic Beasts' and 'Wake Up Dead Man'.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A beautifully animated, heartwarming fantasy adventure that offers pure comfort, epic flights, and funny creature interactions similar to 'Fantastic Beasts'.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, highly entertaining sci-fi romantic comedy that puts a refreshing time-loop spin on the genre, full of existential humor and sweet moments.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest, most fast-paced comedies ever made. Its relentless slapstick and witty banter appeal directly to fans of 'Ace Ventura' and 'Thor: Ragnarok'.
